intro: Confront Lorthuna marks the critical pursuit of High Priestess Lorthuna as she flees through a portal to the Rohashi Spires above Zephras. Adventurers are tasked with reinforcing Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in a desperate battle high above the island. The aftermath leaves key defenders wounded and the future safety of Zephras in question.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Lorthuna fled up to the spires above using some sort of portal. Ayessa and Elaadrin went in after her. That was just a few moments ago.
I'm afraid I took one too many hits and this is where I stay. Go through the portal, find Ayessa and help them stop Lorthuna.
Unless that help that Elaadrin and Ayessa said they sent for arrives soon, you are on your own from here. Good luck, adventurer.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I sent a few of our healers to ensure that Valennia and her remaining forces made it back in one piece. She should be resting in the High Elder's residence now.

Muln has already departed back to Azeroth, but he and I spoke of what is next for the Windshapers and our mission to Azeroth. Unfortunately, the island is more vulnerable than ever now and we need a plan to protect Zephras from what is to come.
